fun_facts: Quinshon Judkins grew up in Montgomery, Alabama, and attended Pike Road High School.
At Ole Miss, Quinshon Judkins set school records in 2022 with 1,567 rushing yards and 16 rushing touchdowns.
Those 1,567 rushing yards were the second-most by a freshman in SEC history, behind Herschel Walker.
In his one season at Ohio State, Quinshon Judkins rushed for 1,060 yards, caught 22 passes for 161 yards, and scored 16 touchdowns. He also became a national champion with the Buckeyes.
In the national championship game, Quinshon Judkins scored three of Ohio State’s four touchdowns.
Across his three college seasons, Quinshon Judkins totaled 4,227 yards from scrimmage and 50 touchdowns.
